item.title: Added · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: On October 6, 2026, OCII's Commission voted to adopt the…
item.description: On October 6, 2026, OCII's Commission voted to adopt the resolution authorizing a memorandum of understanding with FOCIL-MB for Block 12 West. The memorandum is a first step; the minutes record the Executive Director saying the Commission was 'just agreeing to talk'. Source: OCII Commission minutes, regular meeting of Oct 6, 2026, p. 5 (https://sfocii.org/files/minutes/2026-10/20261006_OCII%20Minutes.pdf); OCII Resolution No. 23-2026, headed Adopted October 6, 2026 (https://sfocii.org/files/inline-files/2026023.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: The earlier row (2026-09-24) says a one-story…
item.description: The earlier row (2026-09-24) says a one-story storage building "was demolished, clearing the warehouse from the parcel" (event 2019-05-17). DataSF, permit 201712055462: "description":"demolish 1 story storage bldg","status":"complete","completed_date":"2019-05-17". 2019-05-17 is when the permit was closed. item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: The 2015 property management plan lists Block 12…
item.description: The 2015 property management plan lists Block 12 West as vacant land, but city permits from 2013 and 2017 describe a warehouse or storage building on the lot, which was recorded as demolished in 2019. A June 8, 2023 presentation proposed an environmental review contract with ICF for Blocks 4 East and 12 West; the presentation lists June 20, 2023 as the planned Commission hearing, while the staff memo asking the Commission to authorize the contract is for its November 7, 2023 meeting, with a not-to-exceed amount of $440,817; no source read says when or whether the Commission voted. The 2018 demolition permit milestone records the permit issue date only. Source: https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf ; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/MEMO_MBS%20Blks%204E%2012W%20ICF%20Contract.pdf ; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20MBS%20Environmental%20Consultant%20Affordable%20Housing%20Sites%206.8.23.pdf ; https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=201712055462.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: The Block 12 West page said OCII files minutes under…
item.description: The Block 12 West page said OCII files minutes under the month they are approved. That generalised from one example, so it now says only what was observed: the September 1, 2026 minutes are filed in the 2026-10 folder. The October 6, 2026 meeting page, checked again on October 11, 2026, still lists no minutes and no outcome, so the approval stays unconfirmed. An earlier correction on this page was also reworded to read 'This corrects the note above: the approval is not confirmed.', because the note it corrects is still shown above it. Source: OCII, Commission meeting page, Oct 6, 2026 (https://sfocii.org/public-meetings/commission-meeting/commission-meeting-october-6-2026); OCII, Commission meeting page, Sep 1, 2026 (https://sfocii.org/public-meetings/commission-meeting/commission-meeting-september-1-2026).

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: An earlier note here recorded the OCII Commission's…
item.description: An earlier note here recorded the OCII Commission's approval of the Block 12 West agreement on Oct 6, 2026. It rested on a copy of the resolution marked "Adopted October 6, 2026" that was created the day before the meeting and has an unsigned certification line. The meeting's minutes are not posted, and the meeting page lists no outcome. This corrects the note above: the approval is not confirmed. The question is open on the record page. Source: OCII, Commission meeting page, Oct 6, 2026 (https://sfocii.org/public-meetings/commission-meeting/commission-meeting-october-6-2026); OCII, Resolution No. 23-2026, unsigned copy (https://sfocii.org/files/inline-files/2026023.pdf).

item.title: Expected · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: OCII Commission scheduled to consider… (Oct 6, 2026)
item.description: OCII Commission scheduled to consider authorizing the Block 12 West MOU with FOCIL-MB (about 265 affordable and 270 market-rate units; Resolution No. 23-2026) at its October 6, 2026 meeting. The August 13, 2026 CAC deck had targeted September 2026; the item was not on the September 1 agenda and the September 15 meeting was cancelled. The outcome is the next milestone. (Oct 6, 2026). item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: OCII Commission adopts Resolution No.… (Oct 6, 2026)
item.description: OCII Commission adopts Resolution No. 23-2026, authorizing a Memorandum of Understanding with FOCIL-MB, LLC for Block 12 West (agenda item 5(c)). The minutes of the October 6, 2026 meeting record that "it was voted by five commissioners" that the resolution "be adopted" (p. 5; printed in capitals, given here in normal case). The minutes' own heading for the item (p. 4) and the resolution itself print No. 23-2026; only the adoption line prints 22-2026. This is the vote on the MOU, not an entitlement or a start of construction. (Oct 6, 2026). Source: OCII (primary city agency document), 2026-10-06; OCII (primary city agency document), 2026-10-06; OCII (primary city agency document), 2026-10-06.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: The record no longer calls the parcel a surface…
item.description: The record no longer calls the parcel a surface parking lot or places it at a China Basin St roundabout, because no source read says so; the 2015 property management plan lists it as 'Vacant Lot/Land'. The Aug 13, 2026 item is now a CAC presentation with Commission approval only targeted for September 2026 (not a Commission item); the claim that the Sep 15 Commission meeting was cancelled was removed (no cancellation notice was read); the 2023 item is a proposed contract with an already-selected firm (ICF) rather than a solicitation; the Farallon and 385 Channel facts now cite the 2015 plan and DBI permit M401947; the map use changed from mixed to residential (the CAC slides describe two residential projects); and two entries about permits no longer say a demolition happened or that a cost was revised on a date the permit data does not give. Source: Mission Bay North and South Long-Range Property Management Plan, 2015-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf); OCII, Block 12 West MOU and RFP, Mission Bay CAC, 2026-08-13 (https://sfocii.org/files/2026-08/Item%202%20-%20MBS%2012%20West%20MOU%20and%20RFP.pdf); OCII Commission agenda, 2026-09-01 (https://sfocii.org/files/agenda/2026-08/20260901_Agenda.pdf) (does not state this); OCII, Environmental Review Services for Blocks 4E and 12W, 2023-06-08 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20MBS%20Environmental%20Consultant%20Affordable%20Housing%20Sites%206.8.23.pdf); DBI permit M401947 (https://dbiweb02.sfgov.org/dbipts/?page=Permit&PermitNumber=M401947).

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: OCII presents a proposed personal… (Jun 8, 2023)
item.description: OCII presents a proposed personal services contract with ICF Consulting for environmental review to study increasing the bulk, density and height limits on Blocks 4 East and 12 West, in a June 8, 2023 presentation (the OCII staff memo says it went to the Mission Bay Citizens Advisory Committee at its June 8, 2023 meeting); the deck lists June 20, 2023 as the planned OCII Commission hearing. The OCII staff memo for Agenda Item 5(d), Meeting of November 7, 2023, asks the Commission to authorize the contract with ICF Jones & Stokes, Inc. in an amount not to exceed $440,817 (ICF was the sole respondent to a limited bid); no source read states when or whether the Commission voted. Planning work on this parcel therefore predates the 2026 MOU by several years (Jun 8, 2023). Source: OCII (primary city agency procurement memo), 2023-06-08; OCII (primary city agency document).
item.source: OCII (primary city agency procurement memo), 2023-06-08; OCII (primary city agency document)

item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: The Successor Agency's Approved Long-Range… (Dec 2015)
item.description: The Successor Agency's Approved Long-Range Property Management Plan for Mission Bay lists Block 12 West (APN 8710-006, 'Northeast corner of Channel Street and Mission Bay Drive') among the Mission Bay South 'Affordable Housing Parcels' the Developer (then Catellus, now FOCIL-MB) is obligated to contribute under the 1998 Owner Participation Agreement – establishing the parcel as a designated future affordable-housing development site years before the 2023 environmental-consultant solicitation or the 2026 subdivision MOU (Dec 2015). Source: Successor Agency to the SF Redevelopment Agency (predecessor to OCII); primary city agency document, 2015-12.
